name_reason: Convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> satisfied: domain=chapter, descriptor=ch12_end_scene_char_pos_x_table. 'ch12' is the chapter ID (range 01-30, meaningful domain ID), not a Ghidra address residue (the symbol address is 0x52129, unrelated to 12). The '_x' and '_table' parts correctly reflect the X-position axis and the array data type. Matches the sibling pos_x/pos_y/facing table naming for ch03/ch05/ch07/ch08/ch10 in the same file.
purpose: Chapter 12 end-scene (北山道) per-character battle-tile X coordinates for the 14 characters staged at chapter end; first of three parallel 14-byte placement tables (X @ 0x52129, Y @ 0x52137, facing @ 0x52145).
logic_summary: Read-only const lookup. fd2_chapter_12_end @ 0x237D5 block-copies all 14 bytes (MOV ESI,0x52129; MOVSD/MOVSD/MOVSD/MOVSW onto an on-stack scene block) and passes the block as the X-position argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6. Each entry consumed one byte at a time; no struct stride, no wider access, no sign extension.
element_semantics: Each element = one character's battle-tile X coordinate (small tile coords 8..12), indexed by the in-scene character slot (14 staged characters).
notes: Verified: read_memory @ 0x52129 (first 14 bytes = 0a 0b 09 0c 08 0a 0b 09 0c 08 08 0c 08 0c) matches the src array literal {10,11,9,12,8,10,11,9,12,8,8,12,8,12} exactly. Single READ xref (fd2_chapter_12_end), no writer -> const confirmed. Table boundary 0x52129+14 = 0x52137 = pos_y table start (confirmed in decompiler). asm at 0x237E8 (MOV ESI,0x52129; MOVSD x3 + MOVSW = 14 bytes) confirms the copy described in the src comment. src comment block (chtab.c lines 509-528) is accurate/precise/ASCII -> kept, no src edit. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created concise plate via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (src remains source of truth).
